t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on warm limestone. Top left: a small mono uppercase eyebrow, a large light-weight sans headline and a one-line subhead. Left 58%: a four-row table with mono cells, mono row numerals, hairline column and row rules and a heavier navy header rule for <CONTENT>. Right: a soft 3D isometric render of a matte white polypropylene skid with translucent pale-blue water tanks, white pipe frame and a control cabinet on a white tray, in even studio light, with five navy numbered pin discs and hairline leaders. Square corners, calm.
signature_idea: A clean mono levels table beside a believable white PP skid with translucent tanks, tagged with five navy hotspot pins.
strengths: more believable PP skid than the first take: frame, tanks, cabinet, translucent water
table is clear and well ruled, mono figures read well
navy pins are crisp and on-palette
calm limestone page with good margins
weaknesses: pins 1-5 do not map to the four table rows; the leader idea from the brief is lost
whole table in mono is heavy to read for prose cells
invented figures and document codes in cells (CFU limit, USP number, GUI code)
no steel-blue accent beyond the water
render's rounded pipe bends and domes are fine, but the skid shows unexplained parts
brand_fit_why: Light headline, mono figures, navy pins and a white PP render on limestone are on-brand, but the table and render do not connect and figures are invented.
